description: Rutas y frecuencias del servicio de recolección de residuos sólidos – Serviciudad ESP EICE Dosquebradas is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by SERVICIUDADESP EICE. El conjunto de datos contiene la información de las rutas de recolección de residuos sólidos en el municipio de Dosquebradas, incluyendo los barrios atendidos, las frecuencias del servicio y los días de recolección. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher SERVICIUDADESP EICE. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Vivienda, Ciudad y Territorio. The portal shows 2026-06-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution | NoDerivatives 4.0 International License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
